about: One entry per shelf toy: the owner's review notes (2026-09-23, docs/reviews/2026-09-23/review.md), a verdict, and a proposed tap effect and sound. v: keep = the effect is right (the owner liked it, or a later phase finished it; improved = what that phase changed); more = it has an effect that should be clearer or more dramatic; new = it only hops today and needs its own effect. fix = a visual problem to fix; fixed = what was done about it (and in which phase). interactive = the owner asked for touch-position or drag interaction. Proposals are suggestions; the owner may change them. tools/toy-plan.mjs checks this file against the shelf and writes docs/TOY-PLAN.md. On 2026-09-24 the owner approved every proposal in this file as written, including the sports-ball texture fixes.

cactus.effect: Tiny flowers bloom on the spines, then close.
cactus.sound: Soft pluck with a dry rattle.
cactus.improved: E1: nine magenta flowers (a kit-built add-on) open in a ring round the crown, one after another, then close (3.4 s). Plucks rise with them.

strawberry.effect: Seeds pop out and sparkle, then settle back; the berry blushes redder.
strawberry.improved: E1: the seeds (picked by colour) pop out in a staggered wave and glow, the red flesh blushes deeper, then all settles (2.2 s).

cookie.effect: The jam heart glows and throbs twice like a heartbeat.
cookie.sound: Short crunch and a soft double thump.
cookie.improved: E1: the jam heart (picked by colour) glows red and swells twice like a heartbeat, timed with the two thumps (1.6 s).

bee.owner: Now the right way up. Maybe flap its wings.
bee.effect: Wings buzz in a blur and the bee lifts off a little, then lands.
bee.improved: E1: the wings are rig parts that buzz in a blur while the bee lifts off, tilts and lands (2.2 s).

cluster-fly.owner: Right way up. Do what a fly does: rub its hands together, clean its face, flap its wings.
cluster-fly.effect: Front legs rub together, then the wings flick.
cluster-fly.improved: E1b: grooming like a real fly: the front legs (cut as solid pieces, bending at the knee) rub together, then reach up and wipe the face while the head dips, then a little shake (3 s).

may-beetle.owner: Detail is great but underwhelming; it needs an effect.
may-beetle.effect: Wing cases lift and the fanned antennae spread, then fold.
may-beetle.improved: E1: the wing cases lift and part with a shiver and the fanned antennae spread, then fold (2.6 s).

millipede.owner: Great chance for all the legs to move and the body to stretch out.
millipede.effect: A leg wave ripples down the body while it stretches and curls.
millipede.improved: E1: a leg wave (the legs, picked by colour) ripples down the body while it stretches straight, then curls tighter and relaxes (2.8 s).

bumblebee.effect: Fuzzy body shivers and the wings hum; a slow, clumsy hover.
bumblebee.improved: E1: the fuzzy body shivers, the wings hum and it hovers up with a slow, clumsy wobble, then settles (3 s).

raspberry.owner: Looks really cool; very good resolution.
raspberry.effect: The drupelets bounce one by one in a ripple.
raspberry.improved: E1b: drupelets break off as solid pieces one after another, tumble down to the table and hop back into place (3.2 s).

blackberry.owner: Same as the raspberry: looks great.
blackberry.effect: Drupelets gleam in a wave, like light running over it.
blackberry.improved: E1b: half the glossy drupelets burst off as solid pieces, bounce on the table and glint, then spring back (2.8 s).

blueberry.effect: The bloom (dusty coat) wipes off in a swirl, showing deep blue, then returns.
blueberry.improved: E1b: now like the grape (the owner's favourite): the dark skin peels back towards you in five strips, showing the pale green flesh, then closes (3.2 s).

grape.owner: Looks good. Maybe the skin comes off.
grape.effect: The skin peels back in strips to show the pale flesh, then closes.
grape.improved: E1: four strips of skin peel back from the stem end, the flesh under them turns pale, then the skin closes (3.2 s).

star-cookie.fixed: C1: turned round so the glazed top faces the camera.
star-cookie.effect: Crumbles into pieces and crumbs, then reassembles.
star-cookie.improved: E1: it crumbles into pieces and crumbs that fall away, then puts itself back together (2.8 s).

tomatoes.owner: Fantastic, extremely realistic. Maybe they move around.
tomatoes.effect: The tomatoes roll and jostle each other, then settle.
tomatoes.sound: Soft thuds rolling on a table.
tomatoes.improved: E1c: the plate gives a little shake and a wave of small hops runs round it: four groups of tomatoes land on the four thuds, rocking outward and settling with a wobble. The big ones rock instead of hopping, so no unscanned underside shows (2.6 s).

mandeltorus.owner: Some parts should rotate clockwise and others counterclockwise.
mandeltorus.effect: Rings of the fractal counter-rotate in bands, then lock back.
mandeltorus.improved: E1: alternate rings turn opposite ways with a cyan glow, then lock back (3 s).

basket.owner: A basket of seashells. Neat. No effect.
basket.effect: Shells hop inside the basket one after another.
basket.improved: E1b: seen from above so the shells show; the basket shakes and ten of the biggest shells (urchins, sand dollars, starfish, a scallop) bounce up in turn, spinning, and drop back. The blurry fringe under the basket is hidden (2.6 s).

rubber-duck-real.owner: Squeeze and quack. It must differ from the other rubber duck.
rubber-duck-real.sound: Squeaky squeeze (high whistle) — the other duck quacks.
rubber-duck-real.improved: D: a whole-toy rig. A tap squeezes it flat; it springs back taller, wobbles and settles (1.4 s), with a high rubber squeak (the other duck quacks).

garden-gnome.owner: Hilarious, looks great. Maybe the lantern lights up, or it moves around.
garden-gnome.effect: The lantern lights with a warm glow and the gnome gives a little hop.
garden-gnome.sound: Tiny chuckle-like chirp plus a lamp click.
garden-gnome.improved: E1: the gnome hops and its lantern lights with a warm glow and halo (a flame add-on), then goes out (3.2 s).

wooden-elephant.fixed: C1: soft studio light and the model's normal map baked into the colours, and textures filtered to each splat's size, so the carving reads. The model stays (it is the best CC0 elephant found).
wooden-elephant.effect: Trunk lifts and it rocks on its wooden feet.
wooden-elephant.sound: Wooden knock and a toy trumpet.
wooden-elephant.improved: E1c: the scan's trunk is fused to the forehead, so it could only tear; it is replaced by a kit-built trunk traced from the scan (five segments on ball joints, in the carving's colours). A tap uncurls it straight up to trumpet with a few toots, and it curls back down while the elephant rocks on its feet (2.6 s). A small kit patch covers the forehead where the tip rested.

marble-bust.owner: Looks good. Maybe the face moves and says something.
marble-bust.effect: The head turns to look at you; a speech bubble says a short Latin line.
marble-bust.sound: Stone grind and a low murmur.
marble-bust.improved: E1b: the head turns on its neck (a straight cut, no bending), the jaw drops once per syllable of "SALVE, AMICE!" (a shadowed gap opens between the lips) and the speech bubble appears (3.4 s).

ukulele.owner: Instruments should be played so music comes out.
ukulele.effect: Strings vibrate and it plays a short strum pattern.
ukulele.improved: E1b: played like a real ukulele: a pick sweeps across the strings on each of four strums and the strings shake in a standing wave between the nut and the bridge (2.2 s).

alarm-clock.owner: Hands should move. On tap it should jump up and down and ring like an alarm clock.
alarm-clock.effect: Hands tick all the time; tap rattles it off the table while it rings.
alarm-clock.sound: Old twin-bell alarm ring (differs from the other alarm clock).
alarm-clock.improved: E1: the red second hand ticks all the time. A tap rings the twin bells and the clock rattles across the table (2.4 s).

vintage-camera.fixed: C1: the grain was one-texel aliasing and unlit metal. Textures are now filtered to each splat's size, soft light with gloss is baked in, the lens is dark glass (it was a white disc), and the printed maker's names are painted out.
vintage-camera.owner: Could snap a photo with the flash going off.
vintage-camera.effect: Flash burst from the camera and the view briefly whites out.
vintage-camera.improved: E1: a flash bursts from the camera (a splat add-on) and the whole toy whites out for a moment, with a shutter click and wind-on (1.6 s).

boombox.fixed: C1: filtered textures and baked light; the speakers read as grilles, not static. The small maker badge is painted out.
boombox.effect: Speakers pulse to a beat and the tape reels turn.
boombox.improved: E1: the speakers pump and glow blue on the kick drum and the tape reels turn, two bars (2.6 s).

croissant-real.owner: Must do something different from the other croissant.
croissant-real.effect: Tears in half and steam puffs out.
croissant-real.improved: E1: it tears in half, showing its soft layered inside (an add-on), and a puff of steam rises, then it closes (3 s).

carrot-cake.effect: A slice cuts out and lifts away, showing layers.
carrot-cake.improved: E1: a slice facing you lifts out of the ring, showing crumb and frosting layers on its cut faces and in the gap (3.2 s).

pomegranate.effect: Splits open to show glowing red seeds that spill a little.
pomegranate.sound: Crack and a scatter of beads.
pomegranate.improved: E1: it splits open like a book on a hinge at the bottom, showing faces packed with glowing red seeds; a few seeds tumble out (3.4 s).

lantern.owner: A flame should light up inside, like the other fire toys.
lantern.effect: A flame lights inside with a warm glow and flicker.
lantern.improved: E1: a tap lights a flickering flame inside (an add-on) and warms the glass; tap again to blow it out.

cat-statue.owner: Like the bust: the cat moves a bit.
cat-statue.effect: The head turns and the tail swishes once.
cat-statue.sound: Stone grind and a tiny mew.
cat-statue.improved: E1c: the head is cut on the neck's own slanted plane, measured from the scan, under a red collar that follows the neck all round (no longer sunk into the stone). A tap turns the head right round to look at you, tilts it one way as it mews and the other, and turns it back (2.6 s). The tail stays still: it lies on unscanned ground.

chess-set.owner: Ideally playable. At least: a tap plays a real game, white against black, as a long animation.
chess-set.effect: Plays a famous public-domain game move by move; later, tap a piece then a square to move it.
chess-set.improved: E1b: rebuilt as a kit toy (walnut board, 32 turned pieces). A tap plays Morphy's Opera Game (Paris, 1858) move by move: each piece slides to its square, knights jump, captured pieces go to trays beside the board, each move clacks, and at 17.Rd8# the black king tips over. Tap again and the pieces glide home. E1c: plays any game too. Open a PGN file or paste a game (all the rules: castling, en passant, promotion, disambiguation; a set-up position from FEN; a clear message for a bad file), set the move speed, or go back to the Opera Game (the default). A promoting pawn sinks away and a new queen rises; the loser's king tips over after mate or resignation.

horse-statue.fixed: C1: baked soft light (with the model's normal and occlusion maps) gives it shading, so the marble no longer reads as flat white.
horse-statue.effect: Rears up on its hind legs, then settles.
horse-statue.sound: Stone grind and a whinny-like whistle.
horse-statue.improved: E1c: no more foreleg cuts (the hooves looked broken off). The whole horse above the base rears as one solid piece about its hind hooves, prances at the top and lands with a small bounce (2.6 s).

blob.owner: Interesting; no idea for an effect. The original shapes are really good-looking.
blob.effect: Splits into three small blobs that merge back.
blob.improved: E1: splits into three smaller blobs that wobble apart, then merge back with a jelly bounce (2.8 s).

donut.effect: Sprinkles jump off and rain back down.
donut.improved: E1b: it snaps into chunks that fly apart and tumble (the dough shows inside), the sprinkles spray off, then it all flies back together (2.8 s).

knot.effect: The neon flows along the knot and it ties tighter, then relaxes.
knot.improved: E1b: the knot contorts: waves of swelling loops run round the tube, lifting and twisting it, then it settles back into its trefoil (3 s).

planet.effect: Clouds race around and a day-night band sweeps over it.
planet.improved: E1: the clouds race once round the planet and a night band sweeps across it (2.8 s).

basketball.owner: Balls look good. Bouncing is fine but each should bounce differently.
basketball.effect: Dribble: fast low bounces, then a spin on a fingertip.
basketball.fixed: C1: pebbled rubber (embossed bumps lit from one side), clean black channels in small splats, even splat placement.

soccer-ball.effect: Keepy-uppy: three small kicks with spin.
soccer-ball.fixed: C1: smooth, slightly glossy panels and clean grooved seams; the speckle (the far side showing through gaps) is gone with even splat placement.

american-football.effect: A tight spiral spin in place.
american-football.fixed: C1: pebbled pigskin with a soft sheen, darker seams, crisp white laces.
american-football.owner: The owner (2026-09-24): some sports balls look grainy rather than realistic; the tennis ball should be fuzzy and the American football should look like leathered pigskin. Look at the other balls too.
american-football.improved: E1b: a spiral pass: it flies up nose first, spinning fast about its long axis, the nose tipping over at the top, and lands with a wobble (2.4 s).

tennis-ball.effect: Fast high bounce with the fuzz fluffing out.
tennis-ball.fixed: C1: soft felt in larger round splats with a fuzz of fine hairs standing off it (which also softens the edge), and a clean white seam.
tennis-ball.owner: The owner (2026-09-24): some sports balls look grainy rather than realistic; the tennis ball should be fuzzy and the American football should look like leathered pigskin. Look at the other balls too.

baseball.effect: Curveball: it spins hard and swerves.
baseball.fixed: C1: smooth white leather with a soft sheen and crisp raised red stitches.

softball.effect: Underhand arc and a softer thud.
softball.fixed: C1: smooth yellow leather with a soft sheen and crisp raised red stitches.

beach-ball.effect: Floats up slowly, drifts and bobs down.

golf-ball.effect: Tiny chip hop and a spin-back.

rugby-ball.effect: Tumbles end over end with an odd bounce.
rugby-ball.fixed: C1: an even pebbled grip; clean seams.
rugby-ball.improved: E1b: a punt: it tumbles end over end up and down, lands on a point and takes an awkward bounce before settling (2.6 s).

volleyball.effect: A set then a spike straight down.
volleyball.fixed: C1: smooth leather panels with a sheen and clean fine seams.

water-polo-ball.effect: Bobs on an invisible water line with ripples.

cricket-ball.fixed: C1: polished red leather with a bright highlight and a raised, lit seam.

pool-ball.effect: Clicks forward and spins with back-spin.
pool-ball.fixed: E1b: fully opaque polished resin with a sharp window highlight and a soft room reflection, so the black 8 reads as a solid shiny ball (it looked see-through).

pickleball.effect: Light pop-up with air whistling through the holes.

medicine-ball.effect: Barely lifts and lands with a heavy squash.
medicine-ball.fixed: C1: matte rubber grip (low bumps, no shine), and a faint rim of light on dark pages.

squash-ball.fixed: C1: a faint rim of light around the ball on a dark page (a see-through shell that adds up at the silhouette); invisible on a light page.
squash-ball.owner: Weird; hard to see on dark.
squash-ball.effect: Warms up: glows faintly as it bounces faster.

bouncy-ball.effect: Wild ricochet bounces all over, then home.

marble.effect: Rolls around a little circle; the swirl inside turns.

hockey-puck.fixed: C1: the same faint rim of light, and a little sheen on the rubber.
hockey-puck.effect: Slides and spins flat, throwing up ice sparkle.
hockey-puck.improved: E1c: a slap shot. Sparkling ice chips spray from where the stick hit, and the puck glides flat across the ice, spinning fast, round a wide loop and back to its spot (3 s).

shuttlecock.effect: Flips over and floats down feathers-up.
shuttlecock.improved: E1b: hit up: it flips over cork first and flies up spinning, turns over at the top and floats back down cork first, spinning slower as it falls (3 s).

flying-disc.fixed: C1: glossy plastic with a highlight and two moulded flight rings.
flying-disc.improved: E1b: thrown: it spins fast and flat, banks into a curve, glides round a loop like a returning throw and settles back (3 s).

heart.effect: Racing heartbeat: faster beats with a glow, then calms.
heart.improved: E3: a tap sets the heart racing: the atria then the ventricles squeeze (the ventricles wring a little, the aorta swells), faster and stronger with a warm glow on each squeeze, then it calms to its resting beat (about 5 s).

brain.effect: Sparks of light race across the folds (a thought).
brain.improved: E3: a tap sparks a thought: light races out along the folds of the tapped lobe, then through the next lobes and round the brain, and at the end every lobe flashes at once (about 2.5 s).

eye.owner: Pupil dilation is cool but underwhelming. Let the eye look around by itself, and use a different tap animation.
eye.effect: Idle: the eye looks around. Tap: it blinks, looks at you and the pupil snaps small.
eye.improved: C2: it glances around by itself. A tap blinks (new lids), turns it to look at you and snaps the pupil small (about 2.5 s).

lungs.effect: A deep breath in and out.
lungs.improved: E3: a tap takes a deep breath: both lungs swell out sideways, forwards and down (the airways stay put), hold, then empty past rest and settle back into gentle breathing (about 5 s). After the owner's review the breath is about twice as big.

tooth.owner: Looks good; no idea for an effect.
tooth.effect: A sparkle wipe cleans it bright white.
tooth.improved: E3: a tap polishes it: a bright sheen wipes across from the top left, star sparkles pop where it passes and twinkle again while it gleams, then it settles (about 3.5 s).

kidney.effect: Fluid flows through in pulses along the vessels.
kidney.improved: E3: a tap pumps three pulses through: each runs in along the artery as light, spreads through the kidney as a soft flush while it swells a little, leaves along the vein, and a drop runs down the ureter (about 4.5 s).

lava-lamp.fixed: C1: the glass now tapers into the cap and sits in rolled metal collars top and bottom.
lava-lamp.owner: Moves really well. On tap: blobs move faster, light up or change colours.
lava-lamp.effect: Blobs speed up, glow and shift colour for a few seconds.
lava-lamp.improved: E4: a tap heats the lamp: the wax blobs speed up to about three and a half times, smoothly with no jump, the wax glows and shifts from orange through magenta to gold and the liquid brightens, then it all eases back (about 4.5 s). The glow also shows with motion off.

ice-statue.owner: Let the little white specks move. The swan could melt or break apart.
ice-statue.effect: Specks drift; tap melts the swan into drips, then it refreezes.
ice-statue.improved: E4: a tap melts the ice swan: it slumps, drips fall and a smooth meltwater puddle spreads from under the pedestal; then it refreezes and a frosty white light sweeps up it from the base to the beak (about 5.5 s). Frost specks drift up round it while it is cold, and the Temperature slider still works.

candle.owner: Pretty good; OK as it is.
candle.sound: Soft blow and a match strike.

tornado.effect: Spins up bigger and faster, pulling debris, then weakens.
tornado.improved: E4: a tap spins the tornado up: the funnel widens (most at the foot), whirls round faster and kicks up dust, and the planks, clods and leaves on the field lift one by one, spiral up round the funnel and fall back where they lay as it weakens (about 5 s). Power still works.

rainbow.effect: The arc draws itself colour by colour and sparkles at the ends.
rainbow.improved: E4: a tap wipes the arc away in a blink, then redraws it colour by colour, red first, each band sweeping left to right behind a bright pen, and sparkles burst from both clouds and settle (about 5 s).

iceberg.effect: A chunk calves off and splashes; the berg bobs.
iceberg.improved: E4: a tap cracks a chunk off the berg's front shoulder, showing pale fresh broken faces; it tips into the sea with a crown of spray and a ring of ripples, floats and bobs while the berg bobs and rocks, then melts away as one piece as the berg's chunk grows back in place (about 6 s).

waterfall.effect: A surge: the flow doubles and mist billows.
waterfall.improved: E4: a tap sends a surge: a white-water front runs along the river and over the lip, a wider, thicker sheet of white water unrolls down the curtain with streaks pouring down it, foam spreads over the pool and mist billows up, then it calms (about 5 s).

ocean-wave.effect: The wave curls and breaks into foam.
ocean-wave.improved: E4: a tap breaks the wave: the lip pitches forward and crashes into the flat water in front, turns to white water and falls flat, and clumps of spray burst up and fall back; foam spreads down the face and over the water, then thins away as the lip curls over again from the crest (about 5 s).

geyser.sound: Hiss and a whoosh of steam.

book.fixed: C1: readable words from a 5x7 bitmap font, more and smaller splats on the two open pages, a crisper cover, and no red strip (the cover's inside drew over the pages). E1b: the outside is crisp: evenly spread, denser splats on the cover, spine and page edges, a fine woven cloth and page lines splats can show.
book.owner: Blurry; try to make it more detailed so the writing looks like something.

laptop.owner: Pretty awesome; keep it the same. After E1b: basically perfect, lock it in.
laptop.sound: Keyboard clatter and a start-up chime.
laptop.fixed: E1b: a clean case (no speckle) and real keycaps with letters. Tap a key (or type on your own keyboard) and it goes down and types on the screen; tap or drag on the trackpad to move the pointer and click.

music-box.owner: Animation is basically perfect; it needs music.
music-box.sound: A music-box melody (plucked comb tones) while open.

clock.owner: Does roughly what the scan alarm clock should do; keep them slightly different.
clock.sound: Modern digital-ish ring (different from the scan's twin bells).

sun.owner: Incredible. It should pulse and churn by default, dramatically, like the real Sun. Needs a super effect.
sun.effect: Idle: stronger churning and pulsing. Tap: a big solar flare loops off the surface.
sun.improved: E2: by itself the Sun churns (two layers of bright granules swell and fade in turn), its prominences rise and sink and the corona breathes. A tap sets off a flare: the footpoints flash, a loop of hot gas climbs off the upper limb, swells, and its top breaks away into space (4.6 s).

solar-system.owner: Really cool. Maybe the planets line up for an eclipse.
solar-system.effect: Planets swing into a line and one eclipses the Sun, then orbits resume.
solar-system.improved: E2: every planet swings forward round its orbit into one straight row beside the Sun; the system tips until we look along its plane, Mercury swings on in front of the Sun as a dark dot (a transit) and a pearly eclipse corona flares; then it tips back and the planets swing on round their orbits to where they would have been, spread out again (7 s). The orbits are spaced, and the planets sized, so that no two planets touch, at rest or in the row. Mercury is lit from the Sun and turns as it orbits.

mercury.effect: Quick orbit-like spin and heat shimmer on the day side.
mercury.improved: E2: a tap spins it once, fast, and the side facing the Sun glows red-hot and shimmers, then cools (3.4 s).

venus.effect: The thick clouds swirl fast around it.
venus.improved: E2: a tap whips the clouds round backwards (as Venus turns): the wide equatorial band twice and the polar caps once, so the chevrons shear where they meet, then lock together again (4 s).

earth.effect: Night side lights up with city lights as it turns; clouds move.
earth.improved: E2: a tap turns it through one day with the Sun to the left: night falls over the right half, the Earth turns once, city lights come on as the land turns into the dark and go out at dawn, then the night lifts (6.4 s). The clouds are painted on the globe now.

moon.effect: A lunar module lands; an astronaut plants a flag.
moon.sound: Engine rumble, touchdown thud, lift-off roar.
moon.improved: E2 (redone after review): a tap lands a lunar module near the top of the Moon (it comes down slowing, leaning back, and throws a sheet of dust straight out); an astronaut climbs down the ladder, takes the rolled flag off the leg, bounds over in low-gravity hops, plants it, unrolls it along its crossbar (the flag is a toy option: any country) and waves. A second tap packs up: the flag is rolled and stowed, the astronaut climbs back in and the lander lifts off (10 s each way).

mars.effect: A dust storm sweeps across it.
mars.improved: E2: a tap raises a dust storm: billowing ochre dust sweeps across from the left with a ragged front, covers the whole face and hides the dark markings, then settles, clearing from the east edge (5.4 s).

jupiter.effect: Bands race and the Great Red Spot spins up.
jupiter.improved: E2: a tap sets the cloud bands racing, neighbours in opposite directions (the equator fastest), and the Great Red Spot's swirl spins up inside its oval; each band turns whole turns, so the picture comes back together (4.2 s).

saturn.owner: The rings should move by default.
saturn.effect: Idle: rings turn. Tap: ring particles sparkle and ripple outward.
saturn.improved: E2: the rings turn all the time, inner rings faster, with dark spokes and bright clumps that show the motion. A tap sends two sparkling waves rippling out across the rings (4 s).

uranus.owner: Rings move a little by default too.
uranus.effect: Idle: slow ring motion. Tap: it rolls on its side.
uranus.improved: E2: its thin rings turn slowly all the time (bright arcs show it). A tap rolls it like a wheel, to the right and back, as Uranus lies on its side (3.8 s).

neptune.effect: A dark storm and fast white clouds race by.
neptune.improved: E2: a tap sends the belts of white cloud racing round it twice while the band with the dark storm and its white companion drifts the other way once (3.8 s).

aurora-planet.owner: The auroras should actually move, realistically and dynamically.
aurora-planet.effect: Idle: auroras ripple as curtains. Tap: a bright surge of green and violet.
aurora-planet.improved: E2: the curtains move all the time: bright folds race round the oval, rays flicker and the oval sways. A tap sets off a substorm: the oval flares, a wider curtain with violet tops bursts out towards the equator and the folds race brighter, then it calms (4.2 s).

asteroid.owner: Pretty neat. Maybe it breaks into pieces.
asteroid.effect: Cracks and breaks into pieces that drift apart, then pull back together.
asteroid.sound: Rock crack and a low boom.
asteroid.improved: E2: a tap cracks it (glowing cracks flash), it falls apart into 18 pieces that drift off tumbling, each on its own path, with a puff of dust; the broken faces are paler fresh rock; then gravity pulls the rubble back together and it settles (5.4 s).

comet.fixed: C1: overhauled: a bright icy nucleus in a thin coma, a straight blue ion tail of streamers and a curved gold dust tail.
comet.owner: Extremely underwhelming; does not look like a comet.
comet.effect: Tail flares longer and brighter as it swings by.
comet.improved: E2: a tap swings it past the Sun: jets of gas burst from the sunward side of the nucleus, the coma swells, and both tails flare longer and brighter as they swing round, then fade back (4.8 s).

meteor.effect: Streaks in and bursts in a fireball.
meteor.improved: E2: a tap sends it streaking in from the upper right; it bursts in a fireball, its rock flying apart in glowing fragments that burn out while the trail is snuffed out; then the next one streaks in to take its place (5.4 s).

star.owner: Dynamic like the Sun. Maybe a solar flare, or it evolves into a dying star and dies.
star.effect: Tap runs a life cycle: swells into a red giant, puffs off its shell and leaves a white dwarf, then reforms.
star.improved: E2: a tap runs its life, sped up: it swells into a throbbing red giant, puffs off its outer layers as a glowing shell and shrinks to a tiny white dwarf; then a new star lights up and grows back (8.5 s).

pulsar.owner: Really neat; needs a really cool effect.
pulsar.effect: Beams sweep faster and faster with strobing flashes.
pulsar.improved: E2: each time a beam sweeps past the viewer the star flashes, like a lighthouse. A tap spins it up to a blur, the flashes coming faster into a strobe, each with a tick, then it winds down (5.4 s).

black-hole.owner: Almost perfect as it is; add an effect.
black-hole.effect: A small star falls in, gets stretched into a spiral and swallowed; the disk flares.
black-hole.improved: E2: a tap sends a small star falling in: it spirals closer, faster, is stretched into a streak and leaves a stream of its gas along its path; it plunges in, the disk and photon ring flare, and the stream swirls down after it (6.6 s).

star-cluster.owner: Extremely cool; no idea for an effect.
star-cluster.effect: Stars twinkle in a wave and the cluster breathes in and out.
star-cluster.improved: E2: a tap makes the cluster breathe (in, out and settle, the core first and the outskirts after) while a wave of sparkle runs out from the middle through the stars (4.8 s).

planetary-nebula.effect: The ring expands and glows brighter, then settles.
planetary-nebula.improved: E2: a tap makes the central star flare and blow out a thin bright shock ring; when it reaches the main ring, the ring glows brighter and is pushed outwards, then settles (4.8 s).

nebula.effect: New stars ignite inside the clouds.
nebula.improved: E2: a tap lights seven new stars one after another, three at the tips of the pillars: each flares up with spikes, settles to a bright point in a small glow of lit gas, and later fades (6.5 s).

supernova.owner: Outstanding; keep it as it is.
supernova.sound: Huge boom with a long tail.

spiral-galaxy.owner: No clear effect; it should rotate like a spiral galaxy.
spiral-galaxy.effect: Idle: slow rotation. Tap: arms swirl faster and the core flares.
spiral-galaxy.improved: E2: the spiral pattern now turns slowly all the time, as one piece (the arms keep their shape), while the disc's stars orbit. A tap swirls the arms once more round, fast, and the core flares (4.6 s).

virus.effect: Spikes wave and it splits into copies that fade away.
virus.improved: E3: its spikes sway at rest; a tap sends a wave rippling through them from the front, and two smaller copies bud out from behind it, drift apart along the diagonal, turn and fade away (about 4.5 s).

bacteriophage.owner: Tapping does nothing visible. Upgrade it.
bacteriophage.effect: Make the injection obvious: the legs splay, the sheath contracts a lot further and a glowing DNA strand shoots out of the tail.
bacteriophage.improved: C2: the legs swing out, the sheath snaps to about half its length, the tail pokes through the plate and a glowing DNA strand coils out, then fades (about 4.5 s).

bacterium.effect: Divides in two (binary fission), then merges back.
bacterium.improved: E3: binary fission: the rod pinches in at the middle as a new wall closes across it, its DNA and ribosomes split between the halves, and the two daughter cells come apart with a little hinge (the front one without flagella); then they slide back together and merge (5 s).

red-blood-cell.owner: Maybe turn into a sickle cell, if that is realistic.
red-blood-cell.effect: Deforms into a sickle shape (as in sickle-cell disease at low oxygen), then relaxes back to a disc.
red-blood-cell.improved: E3: sickling at low oxygen: the soft disc stretches and curls into a stiff crescent with pointed ends, holds, then relaxes back into a disc with a little wobble (4 s).

neuron.owner: Decent effect but should be more dramatic.
neuron.effect: A bright pulse runs from the dendrites down the whole axon and bursts at the terminals.
neuron.improved: C2: a bright spark runs from the cell body down the whole axon and bursts into light at the terminals (about 2 s).

astrocyte.effect: Calcium wave: a glow ripples out along its arms.
astrocyte.improved: E3: a calcium wave: a front of green light spreads from the cell body out along every arm to the tips and the end-feet, and the blood vessel they hold widens for a moment; faint waves pass now and then at rest (4.4 s).

animal-cell.owner: Show some process going on inside, like replication.
animal-cell.effect: Cell division: the nucleus splits and the cell pinches into two, then rejoins.
animal-cell.improved: E3: cell division: the nucleus (and its nucleolus and ER) splits into two, then the cell pinches in two across the view, sharing out its mitochondria, vesicles and Golgi; after a moment the two cells flow back into one (5.2 s).

dna.owner: Unzip even further, then zip back up. Almost perfect otherwise.
dna.effect: Unzips all the way, bases light up in pairs, then zips back.
dna.improved: C2: a tap unzips it almost to the foot, the bases light up in pairs as the fork passes, then it zips back up (about 5.5 s).

white-blood-cell.effect: Chases and engulfs a small bacterium (phagocytosis).
white-blood-cell.improved: E3: phagocytosis: a bacterium swims in from the side, the cell leans out and reaches a cup of membrane round it, draws it inside and closes over it; granules gather on it and it glows and shrinks away as it is digested (5.6 s).

microglia.effect: Arms reach out and sweep, then retract.
microglia.improved: E3: its six arms feel about at rest; a tap makes every arm stretch out along its length, sweep to and fro twice, and draw back in (4.4 s).

diatom.effect: The glass shell glints and splits into two halves.
diatom.improved: E3: a glint of light runs across the glass, then the shell parts into its two halves, opening like a clam from its far edge to show the golden chloroplasts inside, and closes again (4.4 s).

tardigrade.owner: Looks great; the effect is awesome.

pollen.effect: Bursts a puff of tiny grains.
pollen.improved: E3: it bursts as pollen does when it soaks up rain: it swells, then a puff of tiny starch granules jets out of its pores (or furrow), stays where it was let go while the grain turns, drifts down and fades (3.8 s).

snowflake.owner: Melt it, or change into another shape.
snowflake.effect: Arms regrow into a new pattern each tap.
snowflake.improved: E3: the arms melt back from their tips to the middle, then a new flake grows out from the centre: three patterns of the chosen kind, one after another, each tap (3.6 s).

chromosome.effect: The sister chromatids pull apart at the centromere, then rejoin.
chromosome.improved: E3: anaphase: spindle fibres reach in from two bright poles to the kinetochores and pull the sister chromatids apart, each led by its centromere with its arms trailing; then they come back together and the fibres let go (4.6 s).

mitochondrion.owner: The powerhouse of the cell; make the effect about that.
mitochondrion.effect: The cristae light up and energy sparks (ATP) pop out.
mitochondrion.improved: E3: it powers up: light runs along the cristae from end to end, the whole thing gives a swell, and bright ATP sparks pop out of the open side in three waves and drift off; faint waves run along it now and then at rest (4 s).

paramecium.effect: Cilia beat in waves and it swims a loop.
paramecium.improved: E3: its cilia beat hard in waves and it swims a full loop in the plane of the view, coming back to where it was (4.2 s).

amoeba.effect: Pushes out a pseudopod and oozes over.
amoeba.improved: E3: it crawls: a round pseudopod pushes out to the right, granules stream into it and the cell oozes over; then one pushes out to the left and it oozes back; at rest its pods stretch a little (5.2 s).

orbital.effect: Jumps to a higher orbital shape with a glow, then drops back and flashes.
orbital.improved: E2: a tap sends in a photon (a wiggle of light) that the electron absorbs: its cloud jumps to the next orbital up (one step up in energy, one more unit of angular momentum) and glows, then drops back with a flash and gives the photon out again (5.2 s).

atom.effect: Electrons speed up into blurred shells.
atom.improved: E2: a tap energises the atom: the electrons whirl faster and faster until each shell blurs into a glowing ring, then slow down (4.6 s). The cloud style's shells swell and brighten.

molecule.effect: Bonds vibrate and stretch (like heat), then calm.
molecule.improved: E2: the atoms always jiggle a little on their bonds. A tap heats it: every bond stretches and squeezes hard at its own pace, the light hydrogens swinging furthest, then it cools (4.4 s). Each atom moves on its own (the buckyball by pentagons, which also breathe). Your own molecule (after the E2 review): type a name (about sixty well-known ones), a formula that names one, or any SMILES string, or open a MOL, SDF, XYZ or PDB file; it is built in 3D (SMILES are embedded with a small force field) and heats up the same way.

protein.owner: (Asked for in the E2 review: a protein toy that can take a PDB file.)
protein.effect: The protein pulls apart into its helices, strands and loops, then locks back together.
protein.sound: Airy rush, then soft wooden clicks.
protein.improved: New after the E2 review: a cartoon of a real structure from the Protein Data Bank (ubiquitin, insulin, GFP, hemoglobin; CC0), helices as coiled bands, strands as flat arrows, loops as tubes, bound molecules (hemes, zinc, GFP's chromophore) as balls and sticks; coloured rainbow start to end, by chain or by structure. Open any PDB or mmCIF file. A tap pulls it apart into its pieces, turning a little, and puts it back (5 s); in GFP the chromophore glows green while the barrel is open.

crystal-lattice.effect: A wave of vibration travels through the lattice.
crystal-lattice.improved: E2: a tap sends a wave of vibration (a phonon) through the crystal: a ripple runs across it from left to right, each slice of atoms rising and falling in turn with its bonds (3.8 s).

diamond.effect: Fire: rainbow sparkles flash off the facets as it turns.
diamond.improved: E2: a tap turns it one way and the other in the light, like a ring: facet after facet flashes rainbow fire and the star glints flare (3.8 s).

ruby.improved: E2: rubies glow red in ultraviolet light. A tap lights the stone deep red from its heart outwards; the glow throbs twice, shines out round it and fades (4 s).

emerald.effect: Green light runs along the step cuts.
emerald.improved: E2: a tap sends green light racing round the edges of the step cut's steps, each step a little behind the one outside it, so the light spirals in to the table (4 s).

amethyst-geode.effect: The geode opens wider and the crystals glow violet.
amethyst-geode.improved: C2: each time it opens, the halves swing wider and the crystals glow violet with twinkling tips, then settle (about 4 s).

sapphire.effect: A star shimmer (asterism) glides across it.
sapphire.improved: E2: a tap catches a six-rayed star (asterism): its rays spread out over the stone from a bright centre, lying on the stone and ending at its edge; it glides across the top with its rays keeping their directions, and the rays draw back in at the far side (3.6 s).

quartz-cluster.effect: Points light up one by one.
quartz-cluster.improved: E2: a tap lights the ten points one by one from left to right, each glowing from within with a glint at its tip (a long and a short spike, each point's turned its own way), with a rising chime for each (4.4 s).

opal.effect: Colour play: flashes of colour roll across it.
opal.improved: E2: a tap rocks the stone in the light while flashes of colour roll across it patch by patch, changing hue as they go (4.2 s).

crystal-ball.owner: Hard to tell what the effect is; make it clearer and more dramatic.
crystal-ball.effect: Mist swirls hard and a glowing shape appears inside, then fades.
crystal-ball.improved: C2: the mist whips round and thins, and a glowing sign rises out of it and fades: a star, a moon or a heart in turn (about 3.5 s).

oak.owner: Shake it and leaves come out.
oak.improved: E4: a tap shakes the tree: the crown rocks on its trunk and forty leaves come loose one after another, each fluttering down on its own swinging path to lie on the grass; then they wither and fresh leaves open in their places (about 6.5 s). In winter a few dead brown leaves still cling to the twigs, and those fall.

pine.owner: Christmas lights and a star appear.
pine.effect: Shakes off a dusting of snow (approved instead of lights, which the decorated tree already has).
pine.improved: E4: a tap shakes off a dusting of snow: the tree rocks and the snow on its boughs drops a pair of tiers at a time, from the top down, in a puff of powder, lies on the ground and melts (about 5 s). On a snowless day a quick shower dusts the boughs first; with Snow on, fresh snow settles on them again afterwards.

palm.owner: Tap it and the coconuts fall.
palm.effect: The coconuts fall and bounce, then regrow.
palm.improved: E4: a tap shakes the crown and the five coconuts (now hanging in a bunch you can see) drop one after another, thump into the sand, bounce twice and roll to a stop, each with its own bonk; new coconuts swell in the crown while the fallen ones are carried off (about 5.5 s).

cherry-blossom.owner: Really cool already. Maybe all the blossoms fall off when touched.
cherry-blossom.effect: All the petals fall in a flurry, then it blooms again.
cherry-blossom.improved: C2: a new tap action shakes the tree: the petals fall in a heavy flurry, the branches go bare, then it blooms again (about 4.5 s).

maple.owner: Same kind of thing as the cherry blossom.
maple.effect: Leaves swirl down in a spiral gust (different from the cherry's gentle fall).
maple.improved: E4: a tap sends a whirling gust: the crown leans into it and forty leaves are torn off and carried round the tree in a widening spiral, tumbling, before they settle in a ring on the grass (the cherry's petals just drift down); then they wither and fresh leaves open (about 7 s).

bonsai.effect: Grows a new branch, then the scissors snip it back.
bonsai.improved: E4: a tap grows a new branch out of the trunk with a pad of leaves on its end; bonsai scissors slide in, open and snip it off at the cut, the piece tips onto the moss and is cleared away, and the stub heals over (about 5 s).

willow.effect: The long branches sway in a wave like a breeze passing.
willow.improved: E4: a tap sends a breeze across the tree from the left: the hanging strands swing away with it a curtain at a time (they bend, most at their tips), swing back and settle, and the crown leans a little (about 5.5 s). The strands also sway gently at rest.

sunflower.effect: The head turns to face the sun and petals open wide.
sunflower.improved: E4: a tap brings out the sun at the top left: the head turns up to face it and all 48 ray petals spread wide open, each turning about its root; then the sun goes in, the head turns back and the petals lift again (about 5.5 s). The head nods gently at rest.

rose.effect: Blooms open further, a petal drops.
rose.improved: E4: a tap opens the bloom further (every petal turns out about its root, the outer ones most) and the outer petal facing you comes loose and flutters down to lie on the grass; the bloom closes up again, the fallen petal withers and a new one fills its place (about 5.5 s).

tulip.effect: Petals open wide to the sun, then close.
tulip.improved: E4: a tap opens the three tulips wide to the sun one after another: each of the eighteen petals turns out about its root and shows the dark stamens and the pale pistil inside; then they close up again (about 5 s).

daisy.effect: Petals spin like a pinwheel (loves me, loves me not).
daisy.improved: E4: a tap spins the big head like a pinwheel, twice round (loves me, loves me not), and it flings off eight petals one after another, a tick each, which flutter down to the grass while the small heads bob; it slows to a stop, the fallen petals wither and new ones fill the gaps (about 5.5 s).

lotus.effect: The flower rises and opens on the water with ripples.
lotus.improved: E4: a tap folds the flower into a bud, lifts it out of the water on its stalk with a ring of light spreading over the water, and opens it wide up in the air, the outer petals first; then it sinks back onto its pad, open, with a second ring (about 6.5 s).

mushroom.effect: Puffs a cloud of glowing spores.
mushroom.improved: E4: a tap bops the big cap: it dips and springs back, and a cloud of glowing spores puffs out from the gills and billows up and out, each spore on its own path, fading as it drifts (about 4 s).

fern.improved: E4: a tap unrolls the two fiddleheads in the middle into two new fronds: each is a chain of six pieces that straighten one joint after another from the base to the tip, their leaflets spreading as they open; they hold, then roll back up into fiddleheads (about 5.5 s).

saguaro.owner: The spines come out, or it is cut in half to show the cactus water inside.
saguaro.effect: The spines shoot out and back; a second tap shows a cut-away with the watery inside.
saguaro.improved: E4: taps take turns. The first shoots every spine out along its own line and draws them back with a quiver; the next slides a wedge out of the trunk to show the inside, wet pale-green flesh round a ring of woody ribs, dripping, then slides it home (about 4.5 s). It acts and sounds unlike the cactus scan, which blooms.

coral.effect: Polyps open and little fish dart out and back.
coral.improved: E4: a tap opens the polyps all over the staghorn coral (tiny tentacled stars spread from their cups) and six little fish dart out of the reef, each on its own path, hover, turn and dart back in; then the polyps close (about 5 s).

pinecone.effect: The scales open wide (as in dry weather) and seeds drift out.
pinecone.improved: E4: a tap opens the cone as in dry weather: every scale tips out from its root, and sixteen winged seeds slip out and spin down like little propellers, each on its own path; then the scales close again (about 5.5 s).

acorn.effect: The caps pop off and a sprout pokes out.
acorn.improved: E4: a tap pops the caps off: each flips through the air and lands upside down on the leaf, and a green sprout pokes out of each acorn and opens two tiny oak leaves; then the sprouts draw back in and the caps hop home (about 5 s).

succulent.effect: The rosette opens and a small flower stalk rises.
succulent.improved: E4: a tap opens the rosette (every leaf tips outward about its root) and a flower stalk rises from the middle and arches over with six little coral bells; then it draws back and the rosette closes (about 5.5 s).

bamboo.effect: Shoots grow tall very fast, segment by segment.
bamboo.improved: E4: three young shoots sit on the ground. A tap makes them shoot up a section at a time, each new section sliding up out of the one below with a hollow knock, carrying the sheathed tip, and a tuft of leaves opens at the top; later they sink back down (about 5.5 s).

rocks.effect: The pebbles drop and scatter, then stack into a cairn.
rocks.improved: E4: a tap tumbles the pebbles: each rolls out over the sand on its own path to lie clear of the others, then five hop one at a time onto a cairn, biggest at the bottom, with a clack each; at the end they all hop back (about 7 s). In the Cairn style the top four topple off and are stacked again.

kelp.owner: Maybe fish eat it; pick something.
kelp.effect: Fish swim in and nibble; the kelp sways away.
kelp.improved: E4: a tap brings three little fish swimming in from the left; each noses up to a blade and takes a few nibbles, and the kelp sways away from them, the nearest stalks first, then swings back as the fish swim off to the right (about 5.5 s). The kelp also sways gently at rest.

ice-cream.owner: Really neat; I like that you can melt it. Make melting part of the tap effect.
ice-cream.effect: Tap melts it: drips run down the cone, then it refreezes.
ice-cream.improved: C2: a tap melts it (the scoops slump and drips run down the cone), then it refreezes (about 5 s). The Warmth slider still works.

watermelon.owner: Cut it in half or into slices.
watermelon.effect: Cuts into slices that fan out.

birthday-cake.sound: Party blower and a cheer-like chime.

cupcake.effect: A cherry drops on top and sprinkles rain down.

lollipop.effect: Spins fast and the swirl hypnotises.

candy-cane.effect: The stripes wind around like a barber pole, then it snaps in two and rejoins.

macarons.effect: They stack themselves into a tower.

gummy-bear.owner: Underwhelming. Press, hold and drag to stretch its arm or body, and let go to spring back with realistic physics.
gummy-bear.effect: Drag to stretch (like the Magnet, with springy release); tap does a jelly jiggle.
gummy-bear.improved: D: drag-to-stretch. With the Orbit tool, a drag that starts on the bear pulls the part you grabbed (up to about a body length) and it springs back with a few wobbles when you let go; a drag beside it still turns the view. A tap still does the jelly jiggle.

pretzel.owner: Some sort of twisting, like the knots.
pretzel.effect: Untwists into a rope and twists back.

croissant.owner: Must differ from the real croissant.
croissant.effect: Puffs up in an oven glow (rising), then flakes fly off.

sushi.owner: Chopsticks lifted by an invisible hand pick up the sushi.
sushi.effect: Chopsticks pick up a roll, dip it and put it back.

taco.owner: Break in half to show what is inside. Really cool taco.
taco.effect: Shell cracks in half and the filling spills out, then it reassembles.

coffee.owner: Needs work. The cream on top could spin in a swirl on tap.
coffee.effect: Latte art swirl spins; steam curls up.
coffee.improved: C2: the latte art twists into a swirl (the middle turns further than the edge) and relaxes back, with a thick curl of steam.

apple.owner: A bite taken out of it, or a worm comes out.
apple.effect: A bite appears (crunch); a second tap, a worm peeks out.

orange.effect: Splits into segments that fan out.

kiwi.effect: Halves open to show the green inside and seeds.

cherries.effect: The pair swings and bounces on its stems.

grapes.effect: Grapes drop off the stem and bounce, then return.

avocado.effect: Splits open and the stone pops out and back.

bricks.owner: Build something random from the blocks.
bricks.effect: Bricks rearrange into a random small build (tower, bridge, animal), different each tap.

rubber-duck.owner: Effect is OK; it needs a quack.
rubber-duck.improved: C2: the same squeeze and hop, now with a bob and rock that settles by about 1.8 s. The quack is Phase D.

dice.owner: Maybe my favourite; rolls feel random like real dice. Keep it.

newtons-cradle.owner: Tapping has no noticeable effect. Make it more interactive.
newtons-cradle.effect: Tap lifts and drops an end ball hard so the clacks are obvious; later, drag a ball back and let go.
newtons-cradle.improved: E1c: a tap lifts the end ball and lets it go. Each strike sends the far ball out, loses a little height and clacks as it lands, the middle balls twitch with the knock, and it dies away over about 9 s. It no longer swings on its own.

puzzle-cube.owner: Only the top row twists (very cool). Move more than the top row; ideally swipe any row or column to solve it; add a shuffle.
puzzle-cube.effect: Tap scrambles with several random layer turns. Later: swipe a face to turn that layer, with a solved check.

kite.effect: A big gust: the kite loops the loop and the tail whips.
kite.sound: Wind gust and a fabric flap.
kite.improved: C2: a big gust loops the kite round while it rises, and the tail whips; the line stays attached (about 3 s).

lorenz.owner: Spin a little more or be more dynamic; looks good when still.
lorenz.effect: A glowing point races along the trail, drawing a new path.
lorenz.improved: C2: a new tap action sends a bright spark racing along the whole path, drawing it again in light that then fades (about 3 s).

mobius.owner: Wow, really neat. Maybe twist a little.
mobius.effect: An ant-like dot walks the single side; the band twists.
mobius.improved: E3: a tap sends a rider on two laps along the middle of the band: after one lap it is underneath (the band has one side), after two it is back on top where it started, while the band twists a little and untwists (about 5 s). After the owner's review the rider is a choice (the Rider option): a blue race car (the default) with spinning wheels, a rolling beach ball, a duck riding a bicycle (wheels and pedals turning) or the ant.

klein-bottle.owner: Not sure it has an effect. Maybe water flows through it; it already kind of does, make that dramatic.
klein-bottle.effect: A clear surge of water flows through the neck and round.
klein-bottle.improved: C2: a new tap action sends a surge of rippling water along the tube and round, and the glass glows (about 4 s).

menger-sponge.owner: No idea for an effect; looks good. The owner calls one of these a favourite and a likely homepage embed (the transcript may refer to the next toy, the hypercube).
menger-sponge.effect: Zooms into itself: the holes open to show the next level down.
menger-sponge.improved: E3: a tap plugs every hole with a solid cube, smallest first, closing the sponge into a plain cube; then it is carved again level by level: the six big cubes slide out of the faces, then the next size down, then the smallest, each fading as it leaves (about 4 s). (Built instead of a zoom, which blurred.)

hypercube.owner: Possibly the favourite and homepage embed (see the Menger sponge).
hypercube.effect: Rotates through the fourth dimension, turning inside out.
hypercube.improved: E3: a tap turns the tesseract once round through the fourth dimension: the pink inner cube swells out to become the outer one while the blue one folds inside, holds a moment, then turns on back to where it started (about 5 s); at rest it rocks gently in 4D.

torus-knot.improved: E3: a tap pulls the knot loose (its lobes stretch out and swirl) and lets go: it springs back past rest into a tight knot and wobbles to a stop like a plucked spring (about 4 s).

gyroid.effect: The surface flows and shifts phase like a breathing sponge.
gyroid.improved: E3: a tap makes the sponge breathe: the surface slides to a shifted level of its own equation, so the orange channels swell as the blue ones narrow, then the other way, and it settles (about 3.8 s).

mandelbulb.effect: Morphs through powers (bulb shapes twist and bloom).
mandelbulb.improved: E3: a tap turns the bulb's seven horizontal discs like the dials of a combination lock: neighbours click round in opposite directions, top to bottom, then back the other way, bottom to top; each turns a seventh of a turn (the bulb's own symmetry), so it lands on the same picture (about 4 s). This replaced a twist after the owner's review.

seashell-spiral.owner: Something to do with hearing the ocean in a seashell.
seashell-spiral.effect: Glows softly and waves ripple out of the opening.
seashell-spiral.improved: E3: a tap lets you hear the sea in the shell: three soft swells of sea-blue light run down the spiral to the mouth, and a ripple rolls out of the opening with each one, widening and fading (about 4.5 s).

shield.owner: Only bounces; find a better effect.
shield.effect: Blocks an invisible hit: it jolts, sparks and the emblem gleams.
shield.sound: A clang, crackling sparks and a shimmer.
shield.improved: E6: it blocks an unseen blow near its top corner: it jolts back and rocks, sparks spray off the iron rim and burn out, a flash marks the spot, and a gleam of light sweeps across the emblem (about 2 s).

crown.effect: Jewels light up in turn and it rises with a glow.
crown.sound: A royal fanfare and a ping for each jewel.
crown.improved: E6: the crown lifts and hovers; its eight jewels light up one after another round the band, each flashing white, golden motes drift up round it, then the jewels go out in turn and it settles (about 4 s).

wizards-orb.owner: Looks really good; develop it further to be more impressive.
wizards-orb.effect: A bigger spell: runes orbit, light bursts and sparks spiral out.
wizards-orb.improved: C2: a bigger spell: a flash fills the glass, the swirl spins up, sparks spiral out in five arms and a ring of runes rises and circles the orb (about 3 s).

jellyfish.owner: Not sure what the effect does; make it more apparent.
jellyfish.effect: A strong pulse that jets it upward, trailing glowing tentacles.
jellyfish.improved: C2: one strong stroke squeezes the bell and jets it up about a third of its size, trailing glowing tentacles, then it drifts down (about 3 s).

fish-school.owner: Swim around more dynamically, like a swarm.
fish-school.effect: The school swirls into a bait ball and scatters.
fish-school.sound: Water swishes and bursts, with bubbles.
fish-school.improved: E6: each fish is now its own piece (48 fish). A tap: the school tightens into a spinning bait ball, bursts outwards head first in every direction as if something struck at it, and swims back into place (5 s).

pufferfish.owner: Should puff: get big, then small.
pufferfish.effect: Inflates to a big spiky ball, then deflates.
pufferfish.improved: C2: it now rests slim; a tap inflates it to a big spiky ball, holds, then deflates with a sputter (about 4 s).

nautilus.effect: Tentacles pull into the shell, then peek back out.
nautilus.sound: A jet of water, the hollow shell, a knock and bubbles.
nautilus.improved: E6: startled, it jets back a little and pulls its tentacles in behind its hood (each shortens towards its base); it waits, peeks out halfway, then slowly reaches out again (about 4.5 s).

snail.owner: Perfect, but it disappears too much when hiding; make it more elegant.
snail.effect: Keep hiding in the shell, but keep the shell clearly visible and ease in more gently.
snail.improved: C2: it hides more gently (2.4 s): eye stalks first, then the head glides under the shell and the foot slides in; the shell stays in view and rocks once.

octopus.owner: Underwhelming; the ink should be much bigger and more dramatic.
octopus.effect: A big ink cloud billows out while it jets away and back.
octopus.improved: C2: a big billowing ink cloud grows behind it while it jets up and away with its arms streaming, then drifts back as the ink thins (about 4.5 s).

sea-urchin.effect: Spines ripple in waves and it creeps along.
sea-urchin.sound: A prickly rustle, wave after wave.
sea-urchin.improved: E6: the spines sweep round the urchin in waves (each tilts on its base, so it stays straight), the pink tube feet reach out, and it creeps a little way to the side and back (about 4.5 s).

frog.owner: Mouth opens and the tongue shoots out.
frog.effect: Tongue shoots out to catch a fly.
frog.sound: A fly's buzz, a flick, a gulp and two croaks.
frog.improved: E6: a fly buzzes in and hovers; the frog's jaw drops, its tongue shoots out, catches the fly and snaps back; the jaw shuts, its eyes sink to push the fly down (frogs swallow with their eyes), and it croaks twice with its throat sac (about 3.5 s).

snowman.owner: Do more than bounce; maybe it melts.
snowman.effect: Melts into a puddle, then rebuilds itself.
snowman.sound: Drips, then a crunch of snow and a twinkle as it rebuilds.
snowman.improved: E6: it melts as solid pieces, not a squash: the snowballs shrink (the head first), drips fall, and the hat, nose, coals, arms and scarf drop off one by one into a spreading puddle; then it builds itself again: the balls grow back from the bottom up and each piece hops back to its place (about 6 s). The Warmth slider melts it the same way.

fireworks.owner: Outstanding. Make each launch different (like the dice), and the burst match the colour of the cannon that fires it.
fireworks.effect: Random shell types each tap; burst colour matches its tube.
fireworks.improved: C2: each tap fires a different tube and shell type (peony, ring, willow or star); the rocket rises from its tube and the burst takes that tube's colour.

decorated-tree.fixed: C1: a faceted gold star facing the viewer, with only a faint glow.
decorated-tree.owner: Lights only show very briefly; make it more dramatic.
decorated-tree.effect: Lights come on and chase in patterns and stay on; the star glows.
decorated-tree.improved: C2: a tap switches the lights on in a sweep up the tree, and they stay on, cycling chase, ripple and steady patterns; the star gets a warm halo. A second tap turns them off.

paper-lantern.owner: Perfect; the physics are really good.

diya.fixed: C1: painted clay (dots, a red line, lotus petals) and dark amber oil with a sheen and the flame's reflection.
diya.effect: The flame grows and a ring of small diyas lights around it.
diya.improved: C2: a tap makes the flame flare and grow, and eight small diyas round the rangoli light one after another and stay lit.

guitar.effect: Keep the strum; strings vibrate visibly.
guitar.sound: A real strummed chord progression (synth plucks).
guitar.improved: C2: the strum rocks the guitar about 13 degrees with a small hop, the strings bend and vibrate one after another, and rings of light pulse out of the soundhole. Music is Phase D.

drum.owner: Could be more dramatic. Fast taps could play longer and faster rolls.
drum.effect: Sticks play a roll; fast repeated taps make faster, longer rolls.
drum.improved: C2: the sticks play a roll; taps within 0.9 s of each other step up through four speeds and make the roll longer (up to 3 s after the last tap).

xylophone.sound: The scale it already plays, as mallet tones.
xylophone.improved: D: a tap on one bar lifts the mallet over that bar, strikes it and plays its note; a tap anywhere else plays the scale. Each bar dips as the mallet hits it. E1c: any tap over the row of bars strikes the nearest bar (easy to hit on a phone). The mallet swings over from wherever it is, lands 0.12 s after the tap with the bar's note, bounces off, and the bar jumps. A tap off the bars still plays the scale.

hot-air-balloon.owner: Could be more dramatic; maybe inflate more.
hot-air-balloon.effect: Burner roars, the envelope swells and it rises higher.
hot-air-balloon.improved: C2: the burner roars a big flame, the envelope swells and glows warm, and the balloon climbs well up, then drifts back down (4 s).

sports-car.fixed: C1: the home camera comes closer.

bus.owner: Not sure what the effect is.
bus.effect: Stop sign swings out, lights flash, doors open.
bus.improved: C2: the school bus stops: warning lights flash, the stop sign swings out and the doors open onto a lit doorway (4.5 s). The double-decker flashes its hazard lights and opens a middle door.

jet.owner: Very solid; bank more to one side or the other.
jet.effect: Climbs and banks hard left then right.
jet.improved: C2: it climbs nose up while banking hard left, then hard right (about 50 degrees each way, 3.5 s).

sailboat.owner: Pretty good; a bit more dramatic.
sailboat.effect: A big gust heels it over with spray.
sailboat.improved: C2: a gust heels it over twice as far with spray at the bow and stern, then it rocks back upright (3.5 s).

submarine.owner: Underwhelming that only the periscope appears and disappears.
submarine.effect: Dives with bubbles, then surfaces and raises the periscope.
submarine.improved: C2: a tap dives it: the periscope drops, bubbles rush from the hull and it sinks, then it surfaces and raises the periscope (5 s).

bicycle.owner: Not sure what the effect is; make it more dramatic.
bicycle.effect: Pedals spin, the wheels turn and the bell rings clearly.
bicycle.improved: C2: the bell shakes with flashing ring lines, and the wheels add five fast turns and the pedals two (2.5 s).

tractor.fixed: C1: a light wisp of exhaust; the cab glass is clear instead of static.

eiffel-tower.effect: Sparkling lights run up the tower and fireworks burst around it.
eiffel-tower.sound: Sparkle, and a boom for each burst.
eiffel-tower.improved: E6: a tap starts the night show: the ironwork lights up gold, a sparkle of white lights climbs the tower, and four fireworks burst round it one after another (blue, white, red and gold), each opening fast, drooping and burning out; then the lights go down (about 4 s).

washington-monument.effect: The reflecting pool shimmers and the flags wave.
washington-monument.sound: A day's breeze and a soft chime at noon.
washington-monument.improved: E6: a day in a few seconds, like a sundial: the sun rises behind the monument, arcs over and sets, the obelisk's shadow swings round the lawn in front, and the flags ripple in the breeze (about 4.5 s). There is no reflecting pool in the model, so the shadow replaced the pool's shimmer.

pyramids.owner: Neat. Maybe put a UFO there, as a joke.
pyramids.effect: A tiny UFO (the Flying saucer) hovers over the Great Pyramid and beams up a camel-shaped cloud of sand.
pyramids.sound: Theremin warble, sand hiss and a zip away.
pyramids.improved: E6: a tiny flying saucer glides in by the Great Pyramid and switches on its beam; sand streams up out of the desert into the shape of a camel, which floats up into the saucer; the saucer wobbles happily and zips away (about 5 s).

supertall.effect: The tower twists further and its lights run upward.
supertall.sound: A rising lift tone and a ding each time the light reaches the top.
supertall.improved: E6: the floors wring round further in twelve rigid bands (the top turns most) while a ring of light runs up the glass, then they unwind with a little sway as a second ring runs up (4 s).

statue-of-liberty.fixed: C1: the crown's seven rays rise higher and taper to sharp, lit points.
statue-of-liberty.owner: Everything else looks fine. Make the effect a good one.
statue-of-liberty.effect: The torch flame flares bright and sparkles drift from it.
statue-of-liberty.sound: Flame whoosh, crackling sparks and a harbour bell.
statue-of-liberty.improved: E6: the torch flares: the flame leaps to twice its size in a halo of light, a warm glow spreads down the statue, and a plume of golden sparks drifts up and away on the breeze and burns out (about 4 s).

white-house.effect: The fountain on the lawn sprays higher and the flag raises.
white-house.improved: E6: the fountain on the south lawn shoots up a tall jet that falls back as spray, the lights come on in the windows one by one and the flag ripples; then the jet sinks and the lights go out one by one (about 4.5 s). The flag stays at the top of its pole, so it never looks like half-mast.

leaning-tower.owner: Lean further and things fall off, like Galileo dropping objects.
leaning-tower.effect: Two balls of different sizes drop from the top and land together.
leaning-tower.sound: The tower grinds, then two thuds at the same moment.
leaning-tower.improved: E6: Galileo's drop: the tower leans a little further, a big iron ball and a small bronze one roll off the top ledge and fall side by side, landing at the same moment with puffs of dust; they bounce, settle and fade, and the tower eases back (about 4 s).

colosseum.effect: Non-violent: a tiny chariot race loops the arena while the crowd cheers (no fighting, per the no-gore rule).
colosseum.improved: E6: a chariot race (no fighting): a crowd fills the seats, and four chariots in the team colours (red, white, blue and green) race a lap and a quarter of the arena in two lanes, swapping the lead, while the crowd jumps and cheers; then they fade away (about 5 s).

parthenon.effect: Tiny robed figures walk between the columns in procession.
parthenon.sound: A lyre plays a walking tune.
parthenon.improved: E6: a procession: eight robed figures, some with baskets and jars on their heads, walk in single file along the temple, round the corner and across the front of its steps, then fade away (about 5.5 s).

stonehenge.effect: Solstice sunrise: the sun rises through the stones and lights them gold.
stonehenge.sound: A low drone and a bell as the stones light.
stonehenge.improved: E6: solstice sunrise: the sun comes up over the far bank, framed by the great trilithon, a golden beam shines through the stones along the monument's axis, and the stones glow gold; then it fades back (about 5 s).

big-ben.owner: No visible effect; make it pronounced or pick something better.
big-ben.effect: Hands spin to the hour, the clock face glows and the bell swings.
big-ben.improved: C2: the hands spin round and land back on the real time, all four dials glow and a bell swings in the now open belfry (4 s).

taj-mahal.effect: Moonlight: the dome glows and the reflecting pool ripples.
taj-mahal.improved: E6: moonlight: night falls on the garden and the buildings, the moon rises behind the Taj, the great dome stays bright white and glows against the night, and moonlight shimmers on the rippling pool; then day comes back (about 5 s).

castle.owner: Pretty good but underwhelming. Knights come out when the drawbridge opens.
castle.effect: The drawbridge drops and tiny knights march out with a banner.
castle.improved: C2: the drawbridge now starts up. A tap lowers it and five small knights march out, the leader with a banner; a second tap marches them back in and raises it.

pagoda.owner: Not sure what the effect is.
pagoda.effect: Wind chimes swing on every roof tier and lanterns light up.
pagoda.improved: C2: wind chimes at every roof corner swing, one tier after another, and two stone lanterns by the path light up, with the doors glowing (4 s).

windmill.owner: Pretty good, but move a little faster.
windmill.effect: Faster sails; the gust spins them up hard.
windmill.improved: C2: the sails turn faster at rest, and a gust spins them up hard for three extra turns (4 s).
